svg.title: ADBC lockup horizontal construction grid
svg.text: The isometric logomark with the name set like the Apache Arrow wordmark. Every size and position comes from the logomark’s grid.
The logomark’s isometric cells, 10 wide × 10/√3 ≈ 5.77 tall (mark = 110 wide). Rows count down from
the mark’s top corner. Its side corners sit 5½ rows down, so the side walls fall on half rows.
APACHE ARROW in Roboto Regular; ADBC in Barlow Bold at 3 times its cap height, as ARROW is to
APACHE in the Apache Arrow wordmark. Both in capitals, normal kerning, no tracking.
APACHE ARROW sits on the top of the first layer’s side wall (row 5½). One wall (2 cells) below it, ADBC
runs from that wall’s bottom (row 7½) to the bottom of the last layer’s side wall (row 17½): two pitches,
10 cells. APACHE ARROW’s caps are a third of that, 3⅓ cells.
At 3 : 1 both lines come out 201.8–202.2 wide, within 0.2%, so the name is flush left and right.
2 cells between the mark and the name, as wide as a wall is tall. The canvas is rows 0–23, from the
top ring’s hidden top edge, plus half a row all round so no point touches its edge.
